subject: general
question:
Select the Venn diagram that best illustrates the relationship between the following classes.

Fathers, Brothers and Males
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given relation is as shown below :

 
• Some fathers are brothers.
 
• All fathers are males.
 
• All brothers are males.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/da1626a6a18e2b1a7502e7dfd862de3ecd703a5da81977e384678880ced99248.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
